title: ElevenLabs: from deepfake scandal to an $11 billion voice company
disclosure: AFFILIATE LINK IN DESCRIPTION - AI VOICE

scenes.label: THE INTERNET
scenes.narration: January 2023. A tiny voice startup opens its beta to the public. Within days, fake celebrity voice clips, some linked to its tool, appear on 4chan.

title: THE VOICE
STARTUP
scenes.subtitle: ELEVENLABS
scenes.narration: That startup was ElevenLabs. Three years later, it was worth eleven billion dollars. So how did it survive its worst week?

scenes.label: WARSAW, POLAND
scenes.narration: The story starts in Warsaw, Poland. Two friends, Mati Staniszewski and Piotr Dabkowski, meet in high school and watch a lot of American movies.

scenes.label: MOVIE NIGHT
scenes.narration: But in Poland, foreign films are often voiced by one flat narrator reading every character. Man, woman, hero, villain: the same voice.
They grow up. Mati becomes a deployment strategist at Palantir. Piotr becomes a machine learning engineer at Google. The movie problem never leaves them.

scenes.label: DAY ONE
scenes.narration: In 2022 they start ElevenLabs. Their first pitch deck is about one thing: AI dubbing that keeps the feeling of the original actor's voice.

scenes.label: RESEARCH LAB
scenes.narration: They build a text-to-speech model that tries to sound less like a robot and more like a person, with emotion and natural pauses.

scenes.label: PUBLIC BETA
scenes.narration: In January 2023 they open a public beta. Anyone can type text and hear it spoken, or clone a voice from a short sample.

scenes.label: THE NEWS
scenes.narration: Then the bad news. Reporters find fake clips of famous people, made to say hateful things. Some posts link to ElevenLabs.

scenes.label: CRISIS ROOM
scenes.narration: On January 30th the company answers in public. It says it can trace audio back to the user, and promises stricter checks on voice cloning.

scenes.label: PRODUCT TEAM
scenes.narration: It could have ended there. Instead, the team keeps shipping: more languages, AI dubbing, and tools for audiobooks and video creators.

scenes.label: DEAL ROOM
scenes.narration: January 2024. An eighty million dollar round, co-led by Andreessen Horowitz. Reports value ElevenLabs at about one point one billion dollars.
The CEO says yearly revenue hit one hundred million after twenty months, then two hundred million, then about three hundred thirty million by late 2025.

scenes.label: SERIES D
scenes.narration: February 2026. A five hundred million dollar round led by Sequoia, at an eleven billion dollar valuation. The CEO talks about a future IPO.

scenes.label: WARSAW OFFICE
scenes.narration: In June 2026, a Polish state-backed fund buys a small stake, reportedly about eleven million dollars. The kids who hated flat dubbing are now a national bet.

scenes.label: HOW TO USE IT
scenes.caption: FREE PLAN
scenes.narration: So how can you use it? ElevenLabs has a free plan. Pricing guides list around ten thousand credits a month, roughly ten minutes of speech.

scenes.label: TRY THIS
scenes.narration: Paste a script, pick a voice, and download a voiceover. For commercial use you need a paid plan. And only clone voices you have permission to use.
